en: A chill is in the air.
This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate.
I am unworthy, master!
We're making progress!  Bring more supplies to repair Dun Baldar!
%s loosens her grasp on the journal she had been clutching.
The kids jump up and down with youthful energy. (PH emote)
I'll tell you more, Karnik, in time. But first, send this traveler'ta Belgrum--there's more business'ta attend to.
You are not worth my time, $n!
I am a master leatherworker, Omarion.
All right, I think I can make it on my own from here.  I don't know who you are... but I owe you one.  Thank you!
Can you feel it, pathetic creatures? The pall over this land is but a precursor. Soon your precious holdings will be in our grasp! You will fall before the might of the Scourge!
You are an agent of their wicked god, fool.  I will see you destroyed!
Show me your wares, Wilhelm.
The Horde Flag was returned to its base by $n!
The goblins win! The goblins win!
Our veterans are entering the field!
Tell me more.
Here we have Stormwind Keep. Built upon the ruins of Stormwind Castle, which was destroyed by the Horde in the first Great War.
Have you come for further training? Shake the dust of the road from your garments, then, and let us get to work.
Why do you chase me, Mechanical Yeti?! WHY?!
Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.
Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
What are the components?
You're Astor Hadren, right?
The swamp was horrible! I was so... so... scared!

Welcome to the Wickerman Festival, $c!$B$BOn the observance of Hallow's End, the Forsaken burn a wickerman in honor of this, the most revered of occasions.  It was on this day that the Banshee Queen herself delivered us from the clutches of the Lich King and the Scourge.  We have remained free ever since.  Those who would have seen us fall are repayed in full... with vengeance!$B$BThe burning of the Wickerman begins at 8:00 PM!
Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.
Our dark master has noticed your trifling, and sends me to bring a message... of doom!

Now why would ye be needing the services of one of those types?  We get enough trouble out of that rogue, Hulfdan Blackbeard, over in The Forlorn Cavern, do I need to be turning my eye to you as well?
Your fate is sealed, Mokvar!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!
Well met, $n. It is good to see that $cs like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.
What staff?
Thank you. The Light be with you both.
Uh huh.  Unholies in War Quarter standing around main building on outer ring of city.
You need to be exalted with the Forsaken of the Undercity before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
NO! What have they done to you!?
Where is Elder Starweave?
DIE, INSECT!
Did you hear something?
Hmm... well, I can't help you quite yet! You have to learn the basics first. Why don't you go see Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind!
%s collapses upon seeing his master die!
This is a lot to think about.
It is Bowen Brisboise that you seek then.  You'll find him inside his house southwest of Brill just on the other side of the bridge at Cold Hearth Manor.
I require training.
Minions of Hakkar, hear your God. The sanctity of this temple has been compromised. Invaders encroach upon holy ground! The Altar of Blood must be protected. Kill them all!
Where can I find Crystal Restore?
Please be patient, we will call your name when it is your turn. We are helping people in the order they appear to us on our screen.
